materials: walnut veneer (Poly Haven walnut_veneer, CC0, desaturated 55% then x[0.95,0.74,0.56] warm mid brown)
mustKeep: rounded-corner wrap shell with grain running continuously around it
two flush drawers, sequence-matched horizontal grain
half-moon finger scoop cut through the top edge of each drawer
four short round tapered legs splayed on both axes
avoid: black or metal hardware (keeps it distinct from the dark walnut nightstand)
